ValidationRule.description: Tenancy must be set for notice types that always target an individual tenant, regardless of the Audience value.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISBLANK(Tenancy__c), OR( ISPICKVAL(Notice_Type__c, "Eviction Notice"), ISPICKVAL(Notice_Type__c, "Inspection Notice"), ISPICKVAL(Notice_Type__c, "Entry Notice"), ISPICKVAL(Notice_Type__c, "Rent Reminder"), ISPICKVAL(Notice_Type__c, "Rent Arrears"), ISPICKVAL(Notice_Type__c, "Breach of Contract"), ISPICKVAL(Notice_Type__c, "Contract Termination") ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Tenancy is required when the Notice Type is Eviction Notice, Inspection Notice, Entry Notice, Rent Reminder, Rent Arrears, Breach of Contract, or Contract Termination.
